markers.title: Header icons under the 44dp minimum
markers.body: The settings gear (top-left) and chat icon (top-right) are 36×36dp — below the iOS HIG 44×44dp tap target minimum. Add invisible padding to expand the hit area without changing the visual icon size.

markers.title: "View reservations" link is undersized
markers.body: The link's rendered box is only 17dp tall — less than half the 44dp minimum — and the same pattern repeats for "View calendar" and "View inventory" further down. Wrap these in a button with real vertical padding.

markers.title: Revenue/trend row reads as clipped content
markers.body: The "$2,698 Revenue" and "↑12% vs yesterday" row renders faded/overlapping at the bottom of the Today card. If this is a card-carousel peek effect it needs a clearer visual treatment; as rendered it looks like a rendering bug, not a deliberate hint.

markers.title: Inconsistent number formatting
markers.body: Stay Throughs shows zero-padded "09" while Cancellations shows bare "0" — same data type, two different formats. Standardise on one (recommend dropping the leading zero everywhere).

markers.title: Widget dates are stale
markers.body: Dynamic Pricing shows "15 Apr 2026 – 29 Apr 2026"; the identical stale range repeats under Available Rooms. Both should derive from today's date (31 Jul 2026) rather than a hardcoded window.

working_well: Stat hierarchy is clear — label above large number reads fast at a glance.
Salmon hero zone cleanly separates today's context from the sections below.
Demand colour coding in the pricing grid (Tue/Wed highlighted) is instantly scannable.
worth_considering: Add a visible '1 of 2' counter or chevron near the Today card if it's meant to be a swipeable carousel — the peek effect alone isn't a strong enough affordance.
Consolidate the repeated 'View X' link pattern into one button component so sizing and padding stay consistent across cards.
